verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own docs say it ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route that any MCP-compatible client can use. Through it, agents can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and search using natural-language prompts. A probe confirmed the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route so any MCP-compatible client can search your indexes directly.
Once configured, you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural language prompts.
Index documents, tune ranking rules, and search Meilisearch through natural conversation in the AI client you already use.
